snippet.title: The Sicilian Roots Of Remothered | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026 BTS
snippet.description:
The Sicily that Stormind Games recreated in Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy is the Sicily the team has always lived, seen, breathed.
This trailer is a visual journey through the real places, textures, colors, and cultural details that shaped the world of Red Nun’s Legacy, stemming directly from the memories of those who developed it.
Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy is coming October 27, 2026.
Wishlist now. Escape later. https://remothered.com/wishlist

---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
